sections.title: Putting the pieces together
sections.content: A family tree is just van egy... ("I have a...") from A1, repeated for each relative — nothing new grammatically, just a bigger cast of nouns to plug in.

items.english: I have a cousin in South Africa.
I have a lot of cousins.

sections.content: sok ("a lot of, many") from A1 works exactly the same way here as anywhere else — sok unokatestvérem, sok barátom, sok időm — always singular after it, just like egy.
